title: The Grandest Game in the World
author: John Dickson Carr
note: Originally written in London in 1946 as Carr's introduction to the anthology 'The Ten Best Detective Novels'; reprinted with the 'Second Thoughts—After 17 Years' postscript in Ellery Queen's Mystery Magazine, March 1963. Text extracted from the e-book collection 'The Door to Doom' (John Dickson Carr). The closing block-quoted paragraph is an editor's afterword, not part of Carr's essay. Page numbers were not available from the source e-book.
